language_model_scaling_and_downstream_re.detail: 180 annealed endpoints of the Megatron-LM scaling ladder (6 arms x 6 rungs x 5 budgets) with their held-out validation loss; the same 180 cells scored on the nine-task downstream suite; the four 1.3B FineWeb-Edu arms at step 190,976; ten RULER needle-retrieval runs; and the transition spectrum of two 1.3B runs. Every table and figure in lm_scaling/tex is generated from these by a script in this repository, and `lm_scaling/reproduce_tables.sh --check` regenerates them and diffs, so the derivation is checkable without a cluster.
